auth.slide1Body: Every CAREZOA provider is background-verified, certified and reviewed by families like yours.
auth.slide2Body: Arrange nursing, elder care and recovery visits for your family — even when you live in another city.
auth.slide3Body: Live visit status, care reports and chat with the provider — without ever sharing personal numbers.
auth.phoneBody: We verify families and providers to keep every visit safe.

signup.welcomeBody: Quality healthcare at your doorstep. Book verified nurses, physiotherapists, and caregivers for your loved ones.
signup.alreadyHaveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
signup.phoneBody: Enter your phone number to create your account. We'll send you a verification code.
signup.profileBody: Help us personalize your experience. This information will be used for booking visits.
signup.termsBody: Please review and accept our terms to complete your registration.
signup.termsContent:
By creating an account, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

1. You agree to provide accurate information during registration.
2. You understand that Carezoa connects you with verified healthcare providers.
3. You acknowledge that all bookings are subject to provider availability.
4. You agree to our payment terms and cancellation policies.
5. You consent to receive notifications about your bookings and care updates.
6. You understand that Carezoa is not liable for the quality of care provided by independent providers.
7. You agree to use the platform responsibly and not for any illegal activities.

For full terms, visit our website.
signup.acceptTerms: I accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

payment.failBody: No money was charged. You can try again from the booking.

visit.otpBody: Share it verbally when the provider arrives. Never over chat or calls.
